title: Unpaired sulfur electrons
hints: Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: Sulfur is $3p^4$. Three single occupations fill the p boxes first and one then pairs, leaving two singles.
statement:
How many unpaired electrons does the isolated ground-state sulfur atom have?

[_]{a}

explanations: This would require pairing too early.
There are only three p orbitals.
The p⁴ pattern has one pair and two singles.
